subject: Demo recap + POC plan for FinServCorp
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Hi Mike —

Great to meet you and the team on the demo today. Thanks for the thoughtful questions and for sharing the high-level goals. Per our conversation, I attached a short POC template to make planning easier. High level proposal below: 

POC objective:
- Validate Redwood inference performance and cost savings on your latency-sensitive transaction routing workload; confirm model quality for intent classification and entity extraction.

Proposed success criteria (examples to refine):
- 95th percentile inference latency <= 150ms for 512-token requests under 100 qps
- Model classification F1 >= 0.92 on held-out FinServ sample set
- End-to-end cost per 1k requests reduced by >= 30% vs current baseline

Scope and timeline:
- Week 0 (kickoff): environment access, sample dataset, security questionnaire answers
- Weeks 1-3: model onboarding, integration test, perf tuning (batching/quantization), monitoring setup
- Week 4: evaluation against success criteria + decision meeting

Owners (please confirm):
- FinServ PM: Mike Johnson (you) — overall success sign-off
- FinServ Ops: Sarah Lee — dataset & infra access
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — POC owner; Dev Patel — SRE/infra support; Ethan Park — integration & tests

Next steps requested from you:
1) Confirm the success criteria above or add/edit items we should measure
2) Share a sample dataset and a contact for network access/privileged credentials (dev or infra)
3) Proposed kickoff window (we suggested Mon/Tue next week)

Attachments: FinServCorp_POC_Template_v1.xlsx (POC milestones & checklist)

If this looks good I’ll slot a 30-min kickoff and loop in Laura from our CS team to handle onboarding details.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Director, Enterprise Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0191

--
Note: attached template contains sections for evaluation metrics, test data checklist, and a simple runbook for the integration.

From: Mike Johnson <mike.johnson@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@finservcorp.com>, Tom Rivera <tom.rivera@finservcorp.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for FinServCorp

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear write-up and template. Quick answers/notes: 

- Success criteria: the items you listed look good as a starting point. Can we add an availability/uptime target during the POC (e.g., 99.5% uptime for the test window) and an SLA for support response times for P0 incidents?
- We’ll provide a 10k sample dataset (anonymized) by EOD Monday. Sarah will own the dataset delivery and infra contact (Tom is our infra lead).
- Security/compliance: before kickoff our security team will want a short summary of data flows and confirmation that logs/audit trails are preserved. Can your team share a one-page security note and any SOC 2 evidence links?

Kickoff windows: Tue 8/18 or Wed 8/19 morning PST work for us. Prefer 10-11am PST.

Tom and Sarah are looped for any infra questions. Also please include any cost estimate for the POC so procurement knows the expectation.

Thanks,

Mike
VP Product, FinServCorp
Mike.Johnson@finservcorp.com

Thanks for the quick reply and the helpful notes. Answers below and next steps.

Cost for POC: for the engagement as scoped (4-week technical POC with reserved infra and Redwood SRE support) estimate is ~$8k-12k depending on peak throughput and any additional private deployment requirements. We’ll finalize a short costs sheet once we confirm expected qps and dataset size.

Kickoff: Tue 8/18 10am PST works for us. I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: introductions, access checklist, validation metrics, and initial integration milestones.

Owners confirmed: Mike (FinServ PM), Sarah (FinServ Ops), Tom (FinServ Infra), Marissa (Redwood POC owner), Dev (Redwood SRE), Ethan (integration), Laura (Redwood CS/onboarding).
